name: Dust Mummy
flavour: Slow. Very, very slow. Still coming.
art_prompt: a goofy stocky mummy wrapped head to toe in loose sandy bandages with a few strips trailing off, thick arms held out in front, two glowing yellow eyes peeking through the wraps and a small crooked grin
motion: shuffling forward in place with stiff heavy steps, arms held out
doc: The wall: slow, thick, fourteen damage a touch. It arrives when a build must have area damage or a way around.

DM-0.note: Pass 22: the first mummy (a Klein still, free Wan clips)

DM-A.note: Tight old bandages, grey-sandy; walks on the zombie clip

recipe.art_prompt: a stocky mummy wrapped head to toe in tight layers of old frayed grey-sandy bandages, no skin showing at all, the face fully wrapped except two glowing yellow eyes peeking through a gap, thick arms held out in front, a few bandage ends trailing
recipe.motion: shuffling forward in place with stiff heavy steps, arms held out in front
recipe.gait: shuffling in place on the spot with stiff heavy steps, the thick arms held out in front, bandages swaying
recipe.anim_negative: extra arms, a third arm, extra legs, a second mummy, skin showing, a face with a nose or mouth
recipe.back_hint: Its back is the same wrapped bandages, the head fully wrapped from behind, the arms held out ahead of it so only the shoulders and elbows show, strips trailing.
recipe.dead_hint: lying flat on its back on the ground, dead: the glowing eyes gone dark, the arms flopped out to the sides, its body stretched out sideways across the picture with its head on the left and its feet on the right
